# InsideFoshan

> An evolving guide to quality home furniture factories in Foshan, China.

InsideFoshan.com is an independent, first-hand resource for international homeowners exploring designer-inspired, factory-direct furniture in Foshan. It is curated by China Furniture Guy (David Tan), who has been visiting Foshan factories since late 2025. Catalogs are a selection—not each factory’s full collection—chosen for variety so visitors can see the core Foshan styles. Showroom photographs on the site were taken on visits, mostly on an iPhone.

The site focuses on direct-to-consumer factories (not a complete directory of every manufacturer in Foshan). Legal factory names and phone numbers are not published; showroom addresses for the listed factories are available on the homepage.

## Pages

- [Factory catalogs and showroom photos](https://insidefoshan.com/): Curated catalogs and real showroom photos from selected Foshan furniture factories (Italian modern, designer, luxury, mid-century, stone tables, chairs, outdoor, mattresses, rugs, cabinetry).
- [Why Foshan?](https://insidefoshan.com/whyfoshan/): Why Foshan became China’s furniture capital, the shift from B2B to factory-direct, and why homeowners travel from afar to shop here.
- [Sourcing tips](https://insidefoshan.com/howtosource/): How to approach buying furniture in Foshan—what to check in catalogs and showrooms before you commit.
- [Pricing examples](https://insidefoshan.com/pricing/): Indicative ex-factory price ranges and real factory quotations, plus a broad landed-cost estimate.

## Optional further help

Serious factory introductions and sourcing questions: https://insidefoshan.com/ (contact via WhatsApp or email on the site). Related sourcing service: https://www.beyondshowrooms.com/
